name: no-self-ingestion
body:
The scanner must never ingest its own caches or build outputs as code. The shared Go build cache lives under the git-common-dir (`.git/apg/facts/go/<cache-key>`); Go writes a generated `_testmain` into it, which must not surface as a package File, and neither must its generated `init`/`main` functions. `target/**` (staged frontends, cargo build outputs) must not be scanned as source, and `.gitignore`d build trees must be excluded by default.

Observed today: `go.apg/gofrontend` emits a File `.git/apg/facts/go/<key>/53/<sha>-d` with no module parent plus `go.apg/gofrontend.test.init#<basename>` / `.main`; the TS frontend scans `target/debug/frontends/tsfrontend/scanner.mjs` and `target/debug/build/apg-*/out/tsfrontend-build/scanner.js`.

Acceptance criteria:
- No File fqn under `.git/` or `target/` appears in the graph.
- The Go frontend emits no function from a generated `_testmain` scratch file.
- The count of `target/**` Files in the graph is zero, in both main and worktrees.
